en.bdb: How earnings of worship could be digested     ?

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਚਰੁ ਝਾਕ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਦੀ ਚੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਚਖੀ।
verses.translit_en: aauchar jhaak bha(n)ddaar dhee chukh lagai chakhee|

en.bdb: To crave for the material of store (for the Sikhs) is improper.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਦੁਕੁਧਾ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਖੀ।
verses.translit_en: hoi dhukudhaa nikalai bhojan mil makhee|

en.bdb: But those who have such a desire, have to return the material, as the fly gone inside with food is vomited out by the body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਸਵੈ ਤਿਣੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਖੀ।
verses.translit_en: raat sukhaalaa kiau savai tin a(n)dhar akhee|

en.bdb: How could he sleep peacefully who has the grass blade in his eye.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਖਾ ਦਬੀ ਅਗਿ ਜਿਉ ਓਹੁ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਰਖੀ।
verses.translit_en: kakhaa dhabee ag jiau oh rahai na rakhee|

en.bdb: As the fire cannot be kept pressed under the dry grass, similarly,

verses.gurmukhi: ਝਾਕ ਝਕਾਈਐ ਝਾਕਵਾਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਖ ਅਭਖੀ।
verses.translit_en: jhaak jhakaieeaai jhaakavaal kar bhakh abhakhee|

en.bdb: The cravings of the caving person cannot be controlled and for him the inedible becomes edible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਾ ਲਖੀ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit_en: gur parasaadhee ubare gur sikhaa lakhee ||15||

en.bdb: The Sikhs of the Guru are millions but only those who attain the grace of the Lord get across  the world ocean).
